architectural_fidelity.reason: The bay window configuration is completely wrong - Cova shows a single centered window where the original has a three-panel bay window with angled side windows; the window has been transformed into an impossible peaked/gabled shape that doesn't exist in the original architecture.

furniture_removal.reason: Room is completely empty with no furniture remnants, ghost outlines, or phantom shadows - clean base achieved.

style_commitment.reason: This is an essentially empty room with a single plant arrangement at the window - there is zero COVAMINIMAL style execution, no furniture, no styling, no design intent whatsoever; this is not 'minimal style' but rather 'absence of design'.

editorial_density.reason: The room contains only one decorative element (plant at window) - no furniture, no art, no textiles, no light fixtures, no surface vignettes; this falls catastrophically short of Architectural Digest editorial standards and resembles an abandoned space rather than a styled room.

photorealism.reason: The architectural elements (walls, floor, baseboards) render reasonably well, but the window treatment is architecturally impossible and the plant appears somewhat pasted-in; lighting is natural and shadows are coherent on existing surfaces.

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers a complete, professionally styled room with cohesive design while Cova provides an empty shell with fundamental architectural errors.
